statements.text: Blue-black starch should appear only in the green patches of Leaf 1.
Leaf 2 should not show blue-black starch because it stayed in the dark.
Blue-black starch should appear in the non-green patches of Leaf 1.

stem:
Namrata looks for starch with iodine after removing green colour from two leaves. Leaf 1 had green and non-green patches and stayed in sunlight. Leaf 2 was all green and stayed in the dark.

Which statements are correct?

teacher.key_rationale: Starch forms in green parts in sunlight, so only Leaf 1’s green patches test positive; Leaf 2 in the dark and non-green patches do not.
